# Building the 12U homelab rack

Finally got the open-frame rack mounted in the closet next to the water heater. Went with a
Rosewill RSV-L4500U 4-post frame instead of a closed cabinet — better airflow, cheaper, and I can
still reach the back for cabling.

## Hardware so far

- 1U patch panel (24-port, Cat6)
- APC Back-UPS Pro 1500VA, mounted on the bottom rail for weight
- Two 1U shelves for the modem and the old NAS until it gets retired
- Cable management arms on both sides — worth every dollar

## Power and cooling

The closet has no vents, so I added a pair of 120mm exhaust fans wired to a thermostat controller
set to kick in above 30°C. Ambient in there creeps up in summer even with the door cracked.

## Cabling

Ran everything through the wall to the office instead of leaving cables draped across the hallway.
Labeled both ends with a Brother P-touch — future me will be grateful.

## Next

Waiting on rack rails for the new 2U server before the migration to Proxmox can start. See the
task tracker for that.
